items.title: Palestinian shot dead during Israeli settler attack on occupied West Bank village

items.title: Chimpanzees in Uganda locked in vicious 'civil war', say researchers
items.title_zh: 研究者们说,
items.summary: The world's largest known group of wild chimpanzees has split and been locked in a vicious "civil war" for the last eight years, according to researchers.
items.summary_zh: 据研究者说,世界上已知最大的一群野生黑猩猩分裂并被锁入了过去八年的一场恶毒"内战".

items.title: Man accused of coercing wife into sex with 120 men goes on trial in Sweden
items.title_zh: 被控强迫妻子与120个男人发生性关系的人在瑞典受审

items.summary: Dutch police have issued a social media plea for victims of an alleged "international sextortion campaign" to come forward, warning that dozens of women and girls were coerced into degrading sexual acts on camera.
items.summary_zh: 荷兰警方发布社交媒体恳求,要求被指称为"国际分泌运动"的受害者站出来,警告数十名妇女和女童被胁迫在相机上进行有辱人格的性行为.

items.title: Russia and Ukraine agree to Orthodox Easter truce
items.title_zh: 俄罗斯和乌克兰同意东正教复活节休战
items.summary: Russia and Ukraine have agreed to a truce for Orthodox Easter, with Vladimir Putin saying he's ordered troops to cease fire "in all directions" this weekend.
items.summary_zh: 俄罗斯和乌克兰已同意对正统复活节停战,弗拉基米尔·普京表示,他命令部队在本周末"从各个方向"停火.

items.summary_zh: 嘻哈文化创始人之一的Afrika Bambataa已逝世,享年68岁,Hip Hop联盟确认.

items.title: India proposes new rules to regulate news and political posts on social media
items.title_zh: 印度提出新规则,规范社交媒体的新闻和政治帖子.
items.summary: The Indian government has proposed changes to extend its regulatory framework to a wider range of online news voices, including influencers and podcasters on platforms such as Facebook, YouTube and X.
items.summary_zh: 印度政府提出修改,将其监管框架扩大到更广泛的在线新闻声音,包括脸书、YouTube和X等平台上的影响力者和播客。

items.title: Fears over West Africa's Islamist insurgency dominate Benin's election campaign
items.title_zh: 对西非伊斯兰叛乱的恐惧支配了贝宁的竞选活动。
items.summary: With growing fears that the militant Islamist insurgency that has engulfed large parts of West Africa is spreading, security has been dominating the campaign trail in Benin - a once-largely peaceful nation.
items.summary_zh: 由于人们日益担心席卷了西非大片地区的好战的伊斯兰叛乱正在蔓延,安全一直在贝宁这个曾经非常和平的国家中占据竞选轨道。

items.title: Ceasefire or no ceasefire, the Middle East's reshuffling is not yet done
items.title_zh: 停火或没有停火,中东的改组尚未完成
items.summary: The best hope for the ceasefire talks in Pakistan is that both the United States and Iran have strong reasons to call a halt to the war. The biggest obstacle to their success is a total absence of trust, no discernible common ground and the fact that Israel, America's full partner in the war, has hugely escalated its onslaught on Lebanon.
items.summary_zh: 巴基斯坦停火谈判的最大希望是,美国和伊朗都有强烈的理由要求停止战争。 阻碍他们成功的最大障碍是完全缺乏信任,没有明显的共同点,以及以色列——美国在这场战争中的全面伙伴——对黎巴嫩的攻击急剧升级。
